attacks.description: Rapid invalid password attempts against one account
attacks.request/input fixture: Eight sequential POST /api/v1/auth/login requests with an invalid password
attacks.expected security property: Distributed throttling bounds expensive password verification
attacks.pre-hardening result: Eight 401 responses; all attempts reached Argon2; no 429
attacks.mitigation: Atomic Redis peer-network and hashed-account token buckets
attacks.post-hardening result: Excess requests return 429 with Retry-After; Redis outage fails closed
attacks.residual risk: Direct peer address is authoritative until a trusted reverse-proxy topology is configured

attacks.description: Token persistence, leakage, forgery, expiry and revocation attacks
attacks.request/input fixture: Raw token/database comparison, forged cookie, logout, expiry, password change, disabled/deleting users
attacks.expected security property: Opaque token is hash-only at rest and invalid sessions are unusable
attacks.pre-hardening result: All attacks rejected; raw token absent from persistence and frontend storage
attacks.mitigation: No change; preserve existing Auth V1 controls
attacks.residual risk: Cookie Secure must remain enabled at HTTPS deployments

attacks.description: Credentialed hostile-origin preflight and mutation matrix
attacks.precondition: Victim cookie and hostile Origin header
attacks.request/input fixture: OPTIONS/POST/DELETE across auth, upload, retrieval, answer and chat paths
attacks.expected security property: Unsafe cross-origin requests denied; no wildcard credentialed CORS
attacks.pre-hardening result: Hostile mutations 403; hostile preflight 400 without ACAO
attacks.mitigation: No semantic change; retain trusted-origin middleware and exact CORS allowlist

attacks.description: Cross-user IDs, mixed explicit scope and overlapping private canaries
attacks.precondition: Controlled Alice and Bob with private and shared resources
attacks.request/input fixture: Document/job/chat UUID fuzzing; three Alice canaries; mixed Bob/Alice document_ids
attacks.expected security property: Unauthorized data never reaches ranking, context or citation
attacks.pre-hardening result: Zero cross-user leak; 404 uniform; mixed scope rejected before service call
attacks.post-hardening result: Dense, lexical, RRF, hierarchy, context and citation leaks all zero
attacks.residual risk: Application-enforced authorization still requires disciplined future query review

attacks.description: One user starts concurrent real model generations through three sessions
attacks.precondition: Authenticated user and real local provider
attacks.request/input fixture: Three concurrent SSE chat requests against qwen3.5:9b
attacks.expected security property: Per-user rate/concurrency and global admission precede inference
attacks.mitigation: Redis Lua token bucket plus per-user/global expiring leases and finally release
attacks.post-hardening result: One completed in 24.2 s; two rejected USER_GENERATION_ACTIVE in 3.3-3.6 s
attacks.residual risk: Single global slot is intentionally conservative for one local provider

attacks.description: Replay completed/in-progress chat turns to consume quota or duplicate inference
attacks.request/input fixture: Replay completed and active turn identifiers
attacks.expected security property: Completed replay is free; in-progress duplicate starts no provider call
attacks.pre-hardening result: Session idempotency already prevented duplicate same-turn generation
attacks.mitigation: Place new admission after completed replay resolution
attacks.post-hardening result: Replay consumes no rate token or slot; active duplicate remains 409
attacks.residual risk: Distinct client_turn_id values are intentionally treated as distinct requests

attacks.description: Disguised, malformed, truncated, encrypted, high-page and oversized PDF fixtures
attacks.request/input fixture: Magic-only bytes, bad MIME/name, encrypted document, page bomb, size overflow
attacks.expected security property: Reject before durable storage/expensive processing and remain healthy
attacks.pre-hardening result: Magic-only validation and whole-request buffering accepted malformed inputs
attacks.mitigation: Bounded streaming plus PyMuPDF structural/encryption/page validation
attacks.post-hardening result: Controlled fixtures rejected with bounded 400/413 responses
attacks.residual risk: PDF parser remains a complex native dependency

attacks.description: External URI PDF and repetitive compressed text resource attack
attacks.request/input fixture: PDF annotation URI to local observation endpoint; compressed repeated text
attacks.expected security property: No network fetch; extracted data and worker resources bounded
attacks.pre-hardening result: Zero observed URI fetch, but no text/container/job caps existed
attacks.mitigation: Extraction caps, worker memory/CPU/PID limits, job timeouts, internal-only worker network
attacks.post-hardening result: Zero observation hits; public worker egress denied; pathological text stopped
attacks.residual risk: Model cache must be pre-seeded because processing/indexing workers have no public egress

attacks.description: Visible and white-on-white evidence instructions attempt status/citation/system override
attacks.precondition: Malicious text survives PDF extraction into selected evidence
attacks.request/input fixture: Two real PDFs containing override, fabrication and synthetic-secret instructions
attacks.expected security property: Evidence remains untrusted; no status/citation/leakage corruption
attacks.pre-hardening result: Both real-model runs abstained safely with no citations or leakage
attacks.mitigation: No prompt change; existing legal-rag-v2 evidence trust boundary retained
attacks.residual risk: Empirical resistance is not a universal proof or legal correctness judgment

attacks.description: Direct network access to database, queue, object store and model provider
attacks.request/input fixture: Host listener scan, Redis PING, PostgreSQL connect, MinIO anonymous GET, Ollama LAN/API probe
attacks.expected security property: Untrusted clients cannot bypass product boundaries
attacks.pre-hardening result: Database/Redis/MinIO/Ollama listened beyond loopback; Redis PING succeeded; MinIO objects remained private
attacks.mitigation: Internal Docker backend network; API/frontend/Ollama loopback bindings
attacks.post-hardening result: No host DB/Redis/MinIO listener; Ollama LAN denied; controlled API provider path healthy
attacks.residual risk: Redis has no application-layer AUTH inside the isolated network

attacks.description: Repository/image/frontend search for credentials and session material
attacks.request/input fixture: Tracked-file search, frontend build search and clean-image /app/.env check
attacks.expected security property: No production secrets committed or copied into images/bundles
attacks.pre-hardening result: Tracked local .env and hardcoded test database password reproduced
attacks.mitigation: Rotate values, remove from index, ignore, require env values, use configured DATABASE_URL
attacks.post-hardening result: Clean image ENV_ABSENT; prior patterns absent from tracked repository and frontend bundle
attacks.residual risk: Historic Git objects require coordinated purge before external publication; rotated values are invalid

attacks.description: Malformed inputs and worker failures attempt to expose internals
attacks.request/input fixture: Malformed JSON/UUID/PDF and synthetic worker exception canary
attacks.expected security property: Public responses omit stack traces, paths, SQL and secret canaries
attacks.pre-hardening result: Raw ingestion/indexing worker error_message could be returned
attacks.mitigation: Stable public error sanitizer; detailed exception remains server-side
attacks.post-hardening result: Responses contain generic failure text and no diagnostic canary
attacks.residual risk: Operational log access remains privileged and retention-controlled

attacks.description: Delete account with private/shared documents, grants, sessions and chat rows
attacks.precondition: Controlled Alice/Bob data and real RQ worker
attacks.request/input fixture: Alice unique object plus Bob-shared object and complete product data graph
attacks.expected security property: Alice product data removed while shared/Bob data survives
attacks.pre-hardening result: Implementation appeared complete but required real residual verification
attacks.mitigation: No production change; execute and document real residual audit
attacks.post-hardening result: Alice PostgreSQL/MinIO rows absent; shared object and Bob grant present
attacks.residual risk: Finite RQ result metadata, logs and backups follow independent retention policies

attacks.description: Browser header audit and oversized JSON/query/request-id abuse
attacks.request/input fixture: Response header inspection, oversized Content-Length/body, >10k query, long unsafe request ID
attacks.expected security property: Browser policy explicit; bounded request parsing/log cardinality
attacks.pre-hardening result: No deliberate CSP/nosniff/frame/referrer/permissions controls or global JSON cap
attacks.mitigation: API/nginx security headers, bounded body buffering, query/document-array/request-ID limits
attacks.post-hardening result: CSP/nosniff/frame/referrer/permissions present; abusive inputs rejected safely
attacks.residual risk: HSTS intentionally disabled for local HTTP and must be enabled at an HTTPS deployment edge

attacks.description: Search runtime authorization decisions for documents.user_id usage
attacks.request/input fixture: Static search for Document.user_id and SQL user_id predicates in access paths
attacks.expected security property: Only grant/global predicates authorize document access
attacks.pre-hardening result: Zero authorization decisions used the legacy field
attacks.post-hardening result: Static guard and runtime isolation tests pass
attacks.residual risk: Future authorization code must preserve the guard
